scope: Follow-up to the existing Barcelona inventory: 16 cultural leads (including already-listed Ateneu), 23 civic locations, nine unintegrated nearby cinemas, 12 regional leads and three seasonal programmes. Programme records are not necessarily distinct physical venues. The 22 integrated cinema directory entries were already verified by live catalogue collection.
method: Official operator programmes, public booking catalogues/APIs, and municipal agendas. Regularity describes screening activity, not guaranteed original-language availability or exact opening days. No tickets or reservations were made.
